title: Editor E0 task 12b, Spotlight read slice: a stored node Spotlight renders on the public page and the website
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. lib/spaces/spotlight.ts: readSpaceSpotlight reads a stored node document with layout.nodes as the truth and a non-empty type-keyed projection in layout.rows (each shown type once, first node's bags), because resolveNodeRowsFor falls back to the starter when rows is empty. spotlightSiteGrid narrows layout.nodes by SITE_SAFE as it does rows. SpaceSpotlight and the hosted Spotlight already render through SpaceProfileModules, which resolves nodes, so they change not at all. Closes the gap named in LIVE-1052 and LIVE-1054.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/spaces/spotlight.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!s.includes('nodeProjection'))bad.push('no type-keyed projection of a node document');if(!/grid\.nodes/.test(s))bad.push('website narrowing ignores nodes');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1055: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a stored node Spotlight loses its projection (the renderers would draw the starter) or the website stops narrowing nodes. Behavior is lib/spaces/spotlight.test.ts.
